acceptance_criteria: A run without --debug records telemetry and /analytics renders real charts of that run
The /streamdeck emulator drives and reflects the live fleet with no hardware
The physical Stream Deck + (if the spike passes) renders and controls the fleet through suspend and replug
Only allowlisted operators can cause dispatch, steer prompts, or merge
end_to_end_proof: /analytics rendering real telemetry of this very run
feature_boundary.completion_condition: All three branches implemented, reviewed, green on develop, merged, documented; AS-217 evidence recorded and /analytics shows this run's real telemetry.

decisions.summary: Direct-HID Node sidecar over OpenDeck plugin host
decisions.rationale: No Linux Elgato runtime; OpenDeck SD+ strip support is weeks old with fresh regressions; official HID spec published; single-process device ownership. OpenDeck remains the fallback if the LCD path fails the spike.
Time-series charts need persisted history; --debug keeps controlling richness, a config default controls existence; #991 and retention are hard blockers.
CONTRIBUTOR is permanently earned by one merged PR; label provenance requires the timeline API; fail closed on ambiguity.

decisions.summary: packages/ with standalone Node package, no workspace/task runner
decisions.rationale: apps/ collides with the Elixir umbrella convention; one package does not justify workspace ceremony; JS coverage stays out of the Mix gate.

requirements.summary: Run telemetry records by default, bounded on both write and read sides
The Analytics page reaches design parity (complexity chart, brush-to-zoom)
The Stream Deck architecture choice is validated on real hardware before device work
Aiur hosts a Node package in a packages/ monorepo layout without disturbing Elixir CI
Aiur exposes read and control surfaces sufficient for an external controller
The Stream Deck surface logic and browser emulator work with no hardware
A physical Stream Deck + renders and controls the fleet reliably day to day
The full workflow is proven end to end with durable evidence
Only allowlisted operators can cause agent dispatch
Untrusted tracker text cannot steer agent prompts
No merge can land without an allowlisted human approval of the latest push
